title: Center Charges Payable from Resident Trust Fund Accounts — Schedule
content:
This schedule lists which Keystone Ridge charges may be paid from the Resident Trust Fund Accounts and on what kind of written authority. It applies alike to all six tiers, Medicaid and Non-Medicaid, Self-Directed, Representative Payee and Guardianship.

## Kinds of authorization

| Center bill | Authority needed |
|---|---|
| Medicaid patient pay | a standing authorization may cover it every month |
| Private room and board | a standing authorization may cover it every month |
| Bed-hold charge | a per-bill authorization naming the specific charge |
| Ancillary charge | a per-bill authorization naming the specific charge |
| Medicare coinsurance | a per-bill authorization naming the specific charge |

## Limits on what is paid

| Term | All tiers |
|---|---|
| Items or services Medicare or Medicaid pays for | may never be charged against the account |
| Optional items or services | charged only when the resident or representative requested them |
| Most a transfer to a center bill may pay | the open balance of the named charge |
| Return of a charge found improper | within 5 business days |

## Items and services that may be charged at the resident's request

Telephone; television and radio; personal comfort items; cosmetic and grooming items and services beyond what the center routinely provides; personal clothing; personal reading matter; gifts; flowers and plants; social events and entertainment outside the activities program; non-covered special care services; a private room that is not therapeutically required; specially prepared food.

## Points of judgement

- A Medicare coinsurance charge cannot be paid under a standing authorization; it needs a per-bill authorization naming that charge.
- A request to pay $412.66 toward a charge whose open balance is $300.15 can move at most $300.15.
